evidence.reason: The shown spool path validates the value and immediately writes canonical(value) to the pending outbox without enforcing any record-size bound. Nothing in the spool path prevents a schema-valid review from exceeding the publish-time RECORD_BYTES limit, so an oversized record can be persisted and later rejected by GitLedger.publish, leaving a permanently blocking pending record. This is an ordinary admission/publish invariant bug, not a new protection requirement.
